posts.author: Storyteller-Hero
posts.body:
I made a list of games while researching Steam RPG prices back in 2021.
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/price-calculating-for-rpgs-2021.136799/
It's been a while so I made another list, this time including discounts from the Steam Winter Sale (December 2025 - January 2026), and added some more games for point of reference including a couple of newer RPG Maker games that caught my eye.
Seeing the prices along with dates of release also gives a bit of perspective in seeing how the developers and publishers are doing their pricing, which has some interesting differences of approach.
Knowing how much has been discounted from the original price also reveals some of the strategies when it comes to pricing and how companies/publishers/devs might perceive the value of their games from one game to the next.
Steam Winter Sale 2025-2026 (December-January)
Note: the original FF I - VI were replaced by their pixel remasters
Note: Many of the big studio games listed originally released on consoles
